channel.title: Dreamo — Cozy Sleep Stories to Fall Asleep
channel.description: Original cozy bedtime sleep stories for adults, set in the gentle village of Lanternmere. A soft voice reads you slowly to sleep over warm ambient music — no ads, ever. Ideal for insomnia, anxiety, and winding down at the end of the day. From Dreamo (@DreamoSleep on YouTube).

item.title: The Cottage by the Mere
item.description: Fall asleep by the fire in a warm stone cottage beside a still, moonlit lake. A cozy 1-hour bedtime sleep story for adults, read softly by a calm female voice over gentle music. For insomnia, anxiety and an overthinking mind. Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/-zcwY8X8G7c

item.title: The Clockmaker's Shop
item.description: A calm male voice reads you slowly to sleep in a snug clockmaker's workshop, warm with lamplight and the soft ticking of a hundred old clocks — like a slow, ticking lullaby. A cozy 1-hour bedtime story for adults. Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/icEqB_CO5_w

item.title: The Bakery at First Light
item.description: Curl up by the glowing ovens of a warm village bakery in the last quiet hour before dawn. A cozy 1-hour sleep story for adults, soft female voice and gentle music to help you fall asleep fast. For insomnia and winding down. Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/iL7OIjJ_1WU

item.title: The Little Train Halt
item.description: Wait on a quiet little platform in the mist, one warm lamp glowing, as the last slow train hums far away in the dark. A calm male voice and a soothing rhythm to carry you off — a cozy 1-hour bedtime story for adults. Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/IvzFdCi0IuE

item.title: The Apothecary's Window
item.description: Step out of the rain into a tiny village apothecary, with lavender drying overhead and lamplight in the glass jars. Elsie reads this gentle Lanternmere bedtime story, followed by a long music-only tail. Around 70 minutes of quiet company for winding down. Watch on YouTube: https://youtu.be/VTh5slk73aM
